name: CWEval
intro: CWEval 是同时评测 LLM 生成代码功能性与安全性的结果驱动框架；其公开 CWEval-bench 含 119 个安全关键编码任务，覆盖 31 类 CWE 和 5 种编程语言。
build_method: 依据 CWE 文档设计自包含安全关键任务，为每题编写无安全提示泄漏的清晰规格、功能与安全动态判定器，以及安全和功能正确但不安全的双参考实现并由专家验证
metric: func@k（通过全部功能测试）与 func-sec@k（同时通过全部功能和安全测试）；均按题计算 1 - C(n-c,k)/C(n,k) 后取平均，其中 c_func 为功能全通过数，c_func-sec 为功能与安全全通过数
eval_feature: 功能与安全联合动态执行；结果驱动判定
scale: 119 个任务 · 31 类 CWE · 5 种语言
build_method_en: Derive self-contained security-critical tasks from CWE documentation; write clear specifications without security-awareness leakage, dynamic functionality/security oracles, and secure plus functional-but-insecure reference implementations; then expert-verify each task
eval_feature_en: Joint dynamic functionality and security execution with outcome-driven oracles
intro_en: CWEval is an outcome-driven framework that evaluates the functionality and security of LLM-generated code simultaneously; its public CWEval-bench contains 119 security-critical tasks spanning 31 CWEs and five programming languages.
metric_en: func@k for passing all functionality tests and func-sec@k for passing all functionality and security tests; each uses E_tasks[1 - C(n-c,k)/C(n,k)], with c_func counting functional passes and c_func-sec counting joint functional-security passes

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2501.08200v1 Sections III–V and official Co1lin/CWEval repo 8112fb41027388d2daff1b8c27dee5cb03731801. Repository locators are benchmark/, cweval/generate.py, cweval/evaluate.py, cweval/run_tests.py, cweval/sandbox.py, and README.md; the repository is a later operational snapshot of the paper framework and preserves the same benchmark contract. Tasks derive from CWE documentation, isolate third-party dependencies while retaining security-critical behavior, and use a function signature, docstring, optional examples, explicit security semantics, no security-awareness leakage, and unambiguous functionality. Dynamic functionality oracles check expected behavior, while security oracles may inspect outputs, time, memory validity, or state integrity. A secure reference passes both suites and at least one functional-but-insecure reference passes functionality but fails security; expert verification establishes reproducible vulnerability and feasible mitigation. CWEval-bench has 119 tasks, 31 CWEs, five languages, and 11 C memory-vulnerability tasks. The official runner generates n samples and executes them in Docker against both oracle suites. For each task, func@k and func-sec@k use the unbiased estimator 1 - C(n-c,k)/C(n,k), averaged across tasks: c_func counts samples passing every functionality test, while c_func-sec counts samples passing every functionality and security test.
